body:
I've been taking DMAE for about 8 weeks and have noticed a wonderful paradoxical effect (unless it IS marketed for this and I am unaware). I started taking it for vanity as it is marketed in my area (Milwaukee, Wisconsin) as an anti-aging supplement.  However, after shunning prescription meds for my diagnoses of rapid-cycling bi-polar illness due to the undesirable side effects (namely weight gain, told you I was vain) it's one of the last seven mortal sins I have yet to conquer), I have found that OTC DMAE WAY outshines any prescription med I could ever get for Bi-polar illness.
I have been a registered nurse for 18 years and have seen many untoward side effects of mood stabilizers, if only the medical profession had more incentive (i.e government funding) to study DMAE as a mood stabilizer maybe it would find a very beneficial alternative to the current prescription modalities.
